purpose: Classify a sufficiently proven PID reuse as a protected non-residual without changing Phase 6FU exact cleanup or Phase 6FV history.

identity.creation_time_comparison: finite absolute difference greater than 1.0 seconds is a clear mismatch; a difference at or below 1.0 seconds is the same creation-time identity component
identity.clock_contract: Do not infer ordering from wall-clock time. Compare independently captured process creation timestamps only; clock adjustment is not absence evidence.

protected_pid_reuse_requirements: current process uses the observed attempt PID
creation time or canonical absolute path clearly differs
at least one trusted query returns a complete current identity
no trusted query matches the original identity
complete trusted queries do not conflict about the current identity
the original identity is absent by confirmed exit or displacement by the proven current identity
no termination was requested for the mismatched current identity
cleanup suppression is released and did not time out
cleanup_suppression_released, exact_cleanup_started, and exact_cleanup_complete markers are present in order
all other attempt identities are confirmed exited or independently protected reuse
no attempt-owned identity is rediscovered after the cleanup summary
the machine-readable decision retains original identity, query evidence, path comparison, time comparison, and stop evidence
final attempt-owned residual count is zero
fail_closed: missing, relative, or unresolved ambiguous path
any trusted query matches the original identity
termination request for a mismatched current identity
matching residual or rediscovery after summary
cleanup suppression not released or timed out

next_phase_boundary.eligible_followup_if_qualified: A separately authorized fresh-root 9-process memory-ceiling population using release-after-close, provisional Kit 16 GiB/tree 17 GiB, Phase 6FU guard plus this policy, and stack-first CDB.
